About.Description: Focalboard is an open source, multilingual, self-hosted project management tool that helps teams plan and track work.
About.LicenseValue: Focalboard is distributed under the Mattermost Source Available License. Copyright (c) 2015-present Mattermost, Inc.
About.Copyright: Copyright (c) 2015-present Mattermost, Inc. All rights reserved. This localized build is maintained for internal use; see the usage tab for details.
About.Usage1: Start the service with Focalboard.exe. The tray icon keeps the server running in the background; right-click it to open the browser, copy the LAN address, or quit.
About.Usage2: The first registered account automatically becomes the administrator and can manage accounts from the member panel. Admins can also edit board content.
About.Usage3: Other members register through an invite link. Each account keeps its own reminder settings (Feishu webhook, lead days, interval and colors).
About.Usage4: The reminder panel is docked on the right side of the board. Use the Reminders button in the top bar to show or hide it and drag the divider to resize it. The hint bar above the board is controlled by topBarEnabled in config.json; its quotes live in quotes.txt.
About.Usage5: All data lives in the data folder (database, attachments and logs). Stop the service before copying the folder for backup.
About.CopyrightDetail: Focalboard is an open source project by Mattermost, Inc., distributed under the Mattermost Source Available License. Copyright (c) 2015-present Mattermost, Inc. All rights reserved. This build adds local workflow and reminder customizations; it is not an official Mattermost release.
About.ThirdParty: Third-party components (React, Go, SQLite and others) remain under their respective licenses.
